content: I choose not to participate in any race war. Violence and division based on race will only perpetuate further harm and suffering. I believe in standing against all forms of discrimination and promoting unity, understanding, and respect for all individuals regardless of their race. Let us strive for peace and harmony among all races, rather than fueling conflict and hatred.
